source: CARE Cambodia (Pailin), "TIP Training on Maize Production" / បទដ្ឋានអនុវត្ដបច្ចេកវិទ្យា ផលិតកម្មដំណំពូតក្របម, 2009. Funded by AusAID (ACIMA project), the European Union (Pailin Food Security Program), and ACIAR (CCPMP project).
text:
2,4-D (product label pictured in the source lists the active ingredient as 2,4-D sodium salt) is a systemic herbicide selective for broadleaf weeds. Note that this is a different active ingredient from atrazine, glyphosate, and paraquat, and the local Pailin-area brand name recorded in the source for this product is not fully legible in the scanned text and is not repeated here to avoid misquoting it.

Timing and method: it is applied after weeds have grown to about 2-4 leaves. Because it is systemic and selective for broadleaf plants, extra caution is required: it will also kill broadleaf crops such as mung bean and soybean if it drifts onto them. Spraying should be done on calm, low-wind days to reduce chemical drift onto neighboring crops.

Toxicity: medium toxicity.
